# #475 Mikael Pawlo gästar Avanzapodden!

**Feed**: avanzapodden  
**Published**: 2026-11-17  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Guest Mikael Pawlo, founder of Mr Green and an investor, discusses his background as an entrepreneur in online gambling, accounting software (Red Flag/Bokio) and startups. On markets, he warns that Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia is a serious risk because of Nvidia's relationship-dependent circular financing and its weak cash conversion. He likes Millicom (Tigo) as a cash generator, has done well copying Anders Ström's insider buys in Kambi, and is still holding Evolution, which he bought at the top. For most investors he recommends a broad US index and monthly saving.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 KAMBI — Kambi | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

The guest copied Anders Ström's insider buys with very good results so far and says he should have bought more Kambi instead of holding Evolution.

#### Reasoning

This is the guest's opinion. He follows insider buying by founder Anders Ström, and his position has done well in percentage terms. He sees Kambi as a better use of capital than his Evolution position. He admits he tends to sell winners too early, which suggests he wants to stay in.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Anders Ström stops buying or starts selling
- if the gains reverse

> *"Däremot har jag bra tajming i Kambi just nu. Så jag tog lite rygg där på Anders Ström. Gjorde några insynsköp."*

---

### 🟢 TIGO — Millicom (Tigo) | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

The listed company the guest would most like to own outright: strong cash generation and a skilled CEO.

#### Reasoning

This is the guest's opinion, partly passed on from his brother-in-law (Rationality Wins on X). Millicom is generating a lot of cash under a capable CEO, which makes it his favourite listed company to own outright. It is a long-term quality view rather than a short-term trade.

#### Sell Triggers

- if cash generation weakens
- if the CEO leaves

> *"Nej men så sprutar ju ut cash i det där bolaget."*

---

### 🟡 EVO — Evolution | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

The guest bought near the top around 1100 SEK and still holds. He thinks the numbers are good but admits he should have switched into Kambi.

#### Reasoning

This is the guest's opinion. He still holds and believes the fundamentals are good enough for an eventual recovery. He also admits that holding is partly behavioural and that rotating out would have been better, so conviction is mixed.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the numbers deteriorate
- if cash conversion weakens

> *"jag tycker siffrorna är ändå bra i det här bolaget, så borde jag tagit loss den och köpt mer Kambi till exempel."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

CEO Huang's sudden exit puts at risk Nvidia's trust-based circular financing and its weak cash conversion.

#### Reasoning

This is the guest's opinion. Nvidia's deals rely on Huang's relationships and handshakes, and revenue is not always followed by cash. If his relationships disappear, payments could become a problem in the short term even though the AI trend continues. The acting CFO may also be more cautious about new financing deals, which could slow growth.

#### Sell Triggers

- if customer payment problems emerge
- if the acting CFO cuts back financing deals

> *"Nej men det här är farligt på riktigt. Det här är ingen bra grej."*

---
